name: Gilded Shadows
description: New York, 1889. The Gilded Age glitters with wealth and ambition while the underclass struggles in darkness.
seed_prompt: A historical drama set during America's Gilded Age, where robber barons and reformers clash.
lore_content:
The year is 1889. Electric lights are transforming Manhattan's skyline while families crowd into tenements on the Lower East Side. It is an age of extremes, where fortunes are made and lost in a day.

Catherine Ashworth was born to privilege on Fifth Avenue. Now 28 and unmarried by choice, she scandalizes society by working as a journalist under a male pseudonym. Her investigations into sweatshop conditions have made enemies of powerful men - including her own father.

Thomas Ashworth built his railroad empire on the backs of immigrant laborers. He genuinely believes his wealth benefits society and cannot understand his daughter's 'radical sympathies.' When workers threaten to strike, he'll do whatever it takes to maintain control.

Dr. Marcus Webb runs a free clinic in Five Points, treating the poor who can't afford proper care. A Black man who earned his medical degree in Paris, he faces constant discrimination despite his brilliance. He's documenting the health effects of tenement living for a report that could force legislative action.

Rosa Benedetti organizes garment workers in secret, risking beatings and arrest. She lost her sister to a factory fire and has sworn that no more workers will die for wealthy men's profits. The labor movement is growing, and Rosa is at its heart.

Detective Sean O'Brien walks between worlds as an Irish cop in a department run by Tammany Hall. He takes the bribes he must take to survive but secretly passes information to reformers. When a society girl is murdered, the pressure to find a convenient suspect puts him in an impossible position.

Madame Celestine runs the most exclusive brothel in the Tenderloin. Her clients include senators, industrialists, and foreign dignitaries. The secrets she holds could topple empires - which is why someone is trying to silence her permanently.

Jacob Stern arrived from Poland with nothing and built a garment business through sheer will. Now he stands between the old ways and the new, trying to treat his workers fairly while competing with those who don't. His sons want to expand; his conscience says otherwise.
